scenario.summary: Guest types a simple product SKU in the search box, opens it, adds it to the cart and opens the cart via View Cart. Head of the class chain: the next methods verify this line item. Declares the record for the whole chain.
steps: Type the SKU in the search box and open the first result
stateChanges: Guest cart: one simple product added (kept for the dependent methods)
assertions: Search box and Add to Cart visible (page-object checks)
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): this method runs first and declares every need and record value of the chain; the migrated class keeps the resolved record in a class field and the later methods read that field, so they have no needs of their own. Consumers: ProductName (name), ProductItemPrice and ProductTotalPrice (unit price), LinksAndButton, RemoveAllLink, RemoveAllFunctionality and ProductImages (cart state only).

Sources imported from the consumers' scans: ProductName -> product.name, ProductPrice -> product.salesPrice (the cart shows the sales price when set: the migrated test uses salesPrice, else retailPrice). InitialQuantity stays a config source of ProductTotalPrice.
Profile (Playwright observations): z-2420004 is an active SimpleProduct in PRODUCTION, inventory 235, required add-ons 0.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
